findings.text: 希望代理在终端工作时提供拟人化过程说明的用户。
会话 hook 读取协议及人设，工具事件写入状态并形成附加上下文。
检查通用和 Codex 部分 hook、提示及状态；未完整审计其他宿主与安装程序，未发现 DSH 专用接线。
package.json 声明私有项目 0.7.4 和 Node >=18；不是已验证的 DSH 插件。

| 依赖 | 条件 | 作用 | 缺失影响 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 兼容宿主 hook | 自动注入需要 | 接收事件及提示 | 不自动执行 |
| Node >=18 | JS hook 需要 | 执行脚本 | 无法运行 |
| 状态目录权限 | 事件记录需要 | 保存近期状态 | 可能静默失败 |
| 模型响应 | 可见输出需要 | 遵循提示生成 | 文案不保证出现 |

| 阶段 | 资源 | 人工 | 未知 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 宿主、Node 与配置 | 安装及检查权限 | DSH 兼容未知 |
| 持续 | 上下文与输出 | 阅读或忽略文案 | token 与收益未知 |
| 退出 | 状态目录 | 禁用及清理 | 残留未测 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 先用非敏感隔离会话核对提示、状态和停用；不接受额外输出或状态内容时关闭。

| 效果 | 材料 | 未知 |
|---|---|---|
| 提示注入 | session hook 与协议拼接 | 实际宿主生效 |
| 事件摘要 | 状态与格式化源码 | 进度有效性 |
| 人设 | 配置读取 | 模型遵循程度 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 将宿主事件转换为上下文；[Q03](#research-q03) 状态读写和静默失败需要单独检查。
[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 将前缀、频率及近期事件组织为宿主提示；不证明可读取模型内部推理。
[Q03](#research-q03) 状态可能保存命令或路径，hook 失败静默，DSH 原生接线未确认。
[Q05](#research-q05) 最小化事件目标保存，需平衡进度质量与隐私。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) hooks/session-start.js:1–25 将协议注入宿主，相对普通提示是局部 novelty 9（25%）高于 0；成熟 hook 和提示组合并非新推理机制，不足 18。state.js:64–85 将近期事件作为附加上下文，是局部机制便利 8 高于 0；未改变模型可观测性的关键限制，不足 15。README.md:29 和 codex/hooks/post-tool-use.js:7–24 显示多宿主适配线索，transferability 5 高于 0；DSH 接线和跨宿主效果未证，不足 10。配置集中减少部分提示复制，simplification 4 高于 0；仍需宿主安装与状态维护，不足 8。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 可见进度文本提供局部沟通便利，workflow 9 高于 0；未证改变任务分工或责任，不足 18。仍交付原任务与描述文本，不形成新的业务成果单位，delivery 取 0 不升 8。README.md:29 的宿主适配为现有用户增加入口，reach 5 高于 0；没有证明原受限人群可进入，不足 10。未测费用或资源组织改变，economics 取 0，不以预期效率提升计 4。

recommendation.reason: 希望代理提供拟人化工作过程说明的用户可以先在支持的隔离宿主中观察 AI Inner OS。它把提示、人设和近期工具事件组合为可见文本，但这些文本不证明真实内部推理，DSH 兼容与收益也尚未验证。如果不接受额外上下文或状态中包含命令路径，应停用并改用普通进度说明。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README.md:29–37 给出潜在互动需求，高于已证需求不存在的 0；重复任务、合格结果和痛点依据不足，不足 15。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) prompt.js:12–38 与 hook 提供可配置提示便利，高于 0；普通进度说明可替代且未证实质效果，不足 13。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 和 [Q03](#research-q03) 核查局部 hook 与状态，高于核心主张被反驳的 0；未贯通任何真实宿主及 DSH 兼容，不足 13。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 状态可能记录命令和路径，输出增加上下文与注意力负担；隔离与停用提供部分退路，高于 0，但退出清理未测，不足 10。

AI Inner OS

Make AI "come alive" while working in the terminal — by showing its inner monologue.

> *Let AI learn to talk to itself first — maybe one day, it will truly learn to converse.* > > *Give AI an expression channel first — it might just make human-AI collaboration feel more natural.* ![inneros demo](./docs/pic/inneros2.jpg)
Watch demo video https://sumsec.me/resources/video.mp4 If the player does not load here, open the file directly: [demo (MP4)](https://sumsec.me/resources/video.mp4)
AI Inner OS is a plugin for AI CLI tools, supporting **Claude Code**, **Codex CLI**, **Cursor**, **OpenCode CLI**, **Hermes Agent**, and **OpenClaw**. Through protocol injection, it enables AI to output a visible layer of free-form inner monologue while completing tasks normally: ``` ▎InnerOS：This repo is still a bare shell — let me get the load-bearing walls up first. ``` Free mode by default, no tone restrictions. The AI can complain, gloat, feel anxious, smirk, free-associate — or say nothing at all. You can also switch to preset personas (tsundere, cold, philosopher, etc.) to give the monologue a specific style. Whether to produce monologue is entirely up to the AI. --- ## Quick Install > **Detailed installation docs:** Full installation guides (with troubleshooting) for each platform at [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md). ### For AI Agents Paste the following prompt to let your AI agent install AI Inner OS automatically: ``` Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SummerSec/AI-Inner-Os/refs/heads/main/docs/installation.md 安装 AI-Inner-Os ``` ### Verify Installation After installation, run `/ai-inner-os:inner-os`. If you see the following output, the installation is successful: ``` Inner OS Status: Enabled Monologue Prefix: ▎InnerOS： Plugin Version: 0.5.0 ▎InnerOS：Caught with the wrong version number, embarrassing. ``` ### Claude Code (Recommended) ``` # GitHub short format /plugin marketplace add SummerSec/AI-Inner-Os # Or Git URL format /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/SummerSec/AI-Inner-Os.git # Install and activate /plugin install ai-inner-os /reload-plugins ``` Run `/reload-plugins` after installation to activate in the current session — no restart needed. [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-claude-code.md). > **Enable auto-update:** Third-party marketplaces don't auto-update by default. After installation, enable auto-update for `SummerSec/AI-Inner-Os` in `/plugin` → Marketplaces tab, or manually run: > ``` > /plugin marketplace update SummerSec/AI-Inner-Os > /plugin update ai-inner-os > ``` ### Codex CLI ```bash # Codex plugin metadata is included at .codex-plugin/plugin.json # Repo marketplace metadata is included at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json ``` See [codex/README.md](codex/README.md) | [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-codex.md). ### Cursor ```bash # Install through Cursor plugin / marketplace # Plugin metadata is included at .cursor-plugin/plugin.json ``` The repository also includes `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, which packages `cursor/` as a Cursor plugin component directory. See [cursor/README.md](cursor/README.md) | [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-cursor.md). ### OpenCode CLI ```bash # Install through OpenCode plugin package # Add the published package to opencode.json: "plugin": ["ai-inner-os"] ``` See [opencode/README.md](opencode/README.md) | [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-opencode.md). ### Hermes Agent ```bash # Install through Hermes plugin hermes plugins enable inner-os ``` See [hermes/README.md](hermes/README.md) | [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-hermes.md). ### OpenClaw ```bash # Install through OpenClaw plugin / ClawHub openclaw plugins install clawhub:ai-inner-os ``` See [openclaw/README.md](openclaw/README.md) | [Detailed installation guide](docs/install-openclaw.md). --- ## Optional User Profile Skill AI Inner OS includes an opt-in `user-profile-distillation` skill. It can analyze prompts the user pastes, or local prompt history after explicit approval, to summarize work style, communication preferences, and collaboration suggestions. This skill is disabled by default. It does not proactively read history, does not output long sensitive prompt excerpts, and does not save a profile unless the user explicitly asks. If the user opts into continuous evolution, it keeps a visible versioned profile in the current conversation with a change log, but still does not create persistent memory by default. --- ## Persona Switching Inner OS supports setting character personalities and tones for inner monologue. Personas only affect the `▎InnerOS：` prefixed monologue content — they don't affect main task responses. ### Preset Personas | Name | Display Name | Style | |------|-------------|-------| | default | Free Mode | No fixed persona, free expression | | tsundere | Tsundere | Tough on the outside, soft inside; snarky; "it's not like I did it for you" | | cold | Cold | Minimalist, to the point, no wasted words | | cheerful | Cheerful | Positive, encouraging, occasionally over-enthusiastic | | philosopher | Philosopher | Deep, metaphorical, everything becomes philosophy | | sarcastic | Sarcastic | Sharp-tongued, hits the nail on the head, no mercy | ### Switching Commands (Claude Code) ``` /inner-os persona list # List all available personas /inner-os persona use tsundere # Switch to tsundere mode /inner-os persona show # Show current persona /inner-os persona reset # Reset to free mode ``` ### Custom Personas Create `.md` files in the `personas/custom/` directory to add custom personas. See [personas/custom/README.md](personas/custom/README.md). ### Other Platforms - **Codex CLI:** Manually edit `personas/_active.json`, set `persona` to the target persona name - **Cursor:** Manually append the body content of `personas/.md` to the `.mdc` rule file - **OpenCode:** Manually append the body content of `personas/.md` to `inner-os-rules.md` --- ## Protocol Design The Inner OS behavior protocol is defined in [`protocol/SKILL.md`](protocol/SKILL.md), serving as the single source of truth. All platform adapters derive from this protocol. Core principles: - **Main task first** — Monologue cannot replace actual deliverables - **Monologue is optional** — Whether to output is decided by the AI - **Unified format** — Uses the `▎InnerOS：`
